simple.summary: אׇמְנָה (ʼomnâh) means adverb, surely First listed occurrence: Gen 20 12.

definitions.full: H546. omnah אָמְנָה adverb (from אֹמֶן by affix ָ ה ) verily, truly , indeed Gen 20:12 (E) Josh 7:20 (JE).
definitions.rootNote: feminine form of 544 (in its usual sense);
